clauses.text: The provisions of Chapter I to Chapter Promulgation of XXIII shall come into force on the day appointed by the the Constitution President by Proclamation.

Parliament shall meet on the day so appointed and the President may, in such Proclamation, specify the time at which Parliament shall so meet. Devo Vassatukalena sassasampattihetu ca phito bhavatu loko ca raja bhavatu dhammiko SIDDHIRASTU
